name: DictionaryDisplayLite
author: Chai Chaimee
description: DictionaryDisplayLite makes managing NVDA speech dictionaries faster and quieter. It condenses list announcements, adds a quick menu, and provides a custom voice dictionary editor with search, validation, and reordering. Hot Keys: Control+Shift+D Single Tap : Open the Voice dictionary dialog Double Tap : Open the Default dictionary dialog Triple Tap (or more) : Open the Temporary dictionary dialog Shift+Windows+D Single Tap : Open the DictionaryDisplayLite quick menu Double Tap : Open Search and Edit Voice Dictionary directly
